fusions.name: Fault Line
fusions.desc: A crack splits the ground 7 tiles ahead of you, dealing 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, to everything along it and leaving each one [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spalled Fist
fusions.desc: You break stone from your own skin at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Granite Mantle
fusions.desc: A mantle of granite absorbs the next 28 damage and raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Built-Up Pressure
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, pressure builds in a stack on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a quake strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
